next.reason: §1985:VII.4.5.2, the sequential REWRITE, is 'REWRITE record-name-1 [FROM identifier-1] [END-REWRITE]' with no INVALID KEY phrase. §2023:14.9.35.2 is one REWRITE format for every organization; it accepts the 1985 form with the same meaning, and §2023:14.9.35.3 SR2 ('Neither the INVALID KEY phrase nor the NOT INVALID KEY phrase shall be specified for a REWRITE statement that references a file with sequential organization') keeps the 1985 sequential restriction. But it adds 'FILE file-name-1', 'FROM literal-1', the retry-phrase and WITH [NO] LOCK, all refused by the 1985 format: wider, no exception condition, CHANGED.
